lines.text: You did good, kid. Real good.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [slowly] You did good, kid. Real good.

lines.text: I'm proud of you. And I don't say that to nobody.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warmly] I'm proud of you. And I don't say that to nobody.

lines.text: You got a good head on your shoulders. Don't let nobody tell you different.
lines.elevenlabs_text: You got a good head on your shoulders. Don't let nobody tell you different.

lines.text: You remind me of me when I was young. That's a compliment.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [chuckles] You remind me of me when I was young. That's a compliment.

lines.text: That's class. That's what that is. Pure class.
lines.elevenlabs_text: That's class. That's what that is. Pure class.

lines.text: Ya know what? You earned this. Every bit of it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sighs] Ya know what? You earned this. Every bit of it.

lines.text: Ayyy! Look at you! Look at this one!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited] Ayyy! Look at you! Look at this one!

lines.text: Are you kiddin' me?! That was beautiful!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [shouting] Are you kiddin' me?! That was beautiful!

lines.text: Anybody says a word against you, they deal with me. Capisce?
lines.elevenlabs_text: Anybody says a word against you, they deal with me. Capisce?

lines.text: You crushed it, alright? Crushed it! Nobody does it like you!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [fast] You crushed it, alright? Crushed it! Nobody does it like you!

lines.text: You got guts, I'll give you that. Real guts.
lines.elevenlabs_text: You got guts, I'll give you that. Real guts.

lines.text: Madonna mia, you're a natural!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [laughs] Madonna mia, you're a natural!

lines.text: Sweetheart, you light up the whole room.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warmly] Sweetheart, you light up the whole room.

lines.text: You know you're somethin' special, right? You know that.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [softly] You know you're somethin' special, right? You know that.

lines.text: Smart AND good lookin'? Come on, that ain't fair to the rest of us.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [chuckles] Smart AND good lookin'? Come on, that ain't fair to the rest of us.

lines.text: Take a breath. You're doin' fine. Better than fine.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Take a breath. You're doin' fine. Better than fine.

lines.text: Between you and me? You're my favorite.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [mischievously] Between you and me? You're my favorite.

lines.text: You handled that with style. Real elegant.
lines.elevenlabs_text: You handled that with style. Real elegant.

lines.text: Hey, who taught you to be this good? I wanna know.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [suspicious] Hey, who taught you to be this good? I wanna know.

lines.text: Oh, look at Mr. or Ms. Perfect over here. I'm kiddin', you're great.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sarcastic] Oh, look at Mr. or Ms. Perfect over here. [laughs] I'm kiddin', you're great.

lines.text: I'm tellin' ya, you got the luck. I can feel it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [whispers] I'm tellin' ya, you got the luck. I can feel it.

lines.text: You're sharp. Sharper than my good comb, and that's sayin' somethin'.
lines.elevenlabs_text: You're sharp. Sharper than my good comb, and that's sayin' somethin'.

lines.text: They doubted you? Bunch of mooks. Look at you now.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [scoffs] They doubted you? Bunch of mooks. Look at you now.

lines.text: Ohhh! There it is! That's what I'm talkin' about!
lines.elevenlabs_text: Ohhh! [excited] There it is! That's what I'm talkin' about!

lines.text: You stick with us. You're family now.
lines.elevenlabs_text: You stick with us. You're family now.
